profile.headline: Frontend/UI Developer | 10+ Years Experience | Angular, React, TypeScript, JavaScript
profile.summary:
I’m a Frontend/UI Developer with over 8 years of hands-on experience building responsive, user-friendly web applications using modern technologies like Angular (15/14/13 and earlier), TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Node.js, and more.

I’ve worked across various industries, including finance and enterprise software, delivering scalable and high-performing applications. My expertise includes component-based architecture, REST API integration, RxJS, Reactive Forms, and building dynamic data-driven UIs using tools like Ag-Grid, Infragistics, and High charts.

I’m a Green Card holder currently based in New Jersey and open to relocation within New Jersey and New York. I’ve consistently contributed to Agile teams and thrive in collaborative environments where quality and performance are key.

Always open to connecting with professionals, recruiters, and companies looking for skilled frontend talent.

📞 Feel free to reach out:
📧 dhrumilpkumar@gmail.com
